crossRefs.note: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.
You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice…
and said, “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have…
“Go, and tell Hezekiah, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears.…
He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able…

translations.web: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for Yahweh has heard the voice of my weeping.
translations.bsb: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
translations.kjv: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
translations.asv: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.
